Thus at least one coordinate polynomial for each non-reset pair is nonzero despite temporal weight tying. Equality is contained in its proper algebraic zero set.
The finite union over all length-L pairs is null; outside it equality holds exactly for reset-equivalent pairs.
Joint absolute continuity suffices for the probability-one corollary; independent nondegenerate continuous-density perturbations are sufficient but not necessary.
